messages:
maria_csm: heads-up — renewal conversation with OpalMetrics acct#892. They're asking to move from 12mo -> 9mo and want price pro-rated. Procurement is holding on vendor_code and PO number. cc: @jon_finance @lee_legal. low usage signals, want enablement before sign.
jon_finance: ok — net30 vs cc? procurement said they prefer bank transfer (wire), worried about card limits. we need to confirm billing entity and VAT.
sarah_sales: they're pushing for shorter term to match budget cycles. happy to agree if we keep list price but prorate. can we do a one-time onboarding credit instead of discount? helps ARR.
maria_csm: goal = keep ARR intact. propose: 9mo at list, prorated invoice on day1, 1x $2k onboarding credit if they sign by EoM. thoughts?
lee_legal: need SOW addendum + signature path. if procurement insists on wet signature for their internal audit we should allow, but record retention rules apply. any export control or data residency clauses?
devon_se: enablement plan ready — onboarding workshop scheduled week after sign. can bundle a 2-hr workshop + 30d follow-up. that'll increase adoption.
alex_support: note: current usage shows one heavy project, otherwise idle. SE onboarding will help mitigate churn risk.
jon_finance: vendor_code: OPAL-INTL-502 required for their AP. procurement_bot: please attach PO template request.
procurement_bot: Received request. Template: ``PO_LINE_1: Redwood Inference Subscription
PO_LINE_2: Qty 1
PO_LINE_3: Term 9 months (prorated)
PO_LINE_4: Amount: $XX,XXX
PO_LINE_5: Vendor Code: OPAL-INTL-502
``
sarah_sales: follow-up ask — payment method: if wire, we need bank details + payment timing (net30). if charge card, we can tokenise and invoice net0.
maria_csm: customer asked specifically for 'DocuSign preferred but we need a witness for EU signers' — @lee_legal can we confirm EU e-sign compliance and if witness is required?
lee_legal: EU: generally e-sign ok, but some public entities still require witnessing. if they ask we can accept wet signature scanned + witness attestation. add clause: "Electronic or witnessed wet signature acceptable."
jon_finance: cash collection risk: if wired we'll mark renewal as 'at risk' until funds cleared. ops: tag as payment-dependent.
devon_se: I'll link the enablement slot to the SOW so we only run workshop post-payment.
maria_csm: action items: 1) Legal to confirm signature clause (lee) 2) Finance to confirm invoice schedule + vendor_code acceptance (jon) 3) Sales to sign PO terms (sarah) 4) SE to prep kickoff only after signed PO + payment (devon). I'll update the CSM playbook and chase procurement for PO number.
sarah_sales: pinging buyer contact: tina_procurement@opal — asked for vendor code confirmation and PO ETA.
alex_support: logging: account health = "yellow" (low adoption) — renewal risk medium unless enablement executed quickly.
maria_csm: thanks team — i'll propose the 9mo/prorate + $2k onboarding credit and push for DocuSign with witness fallback. will update thread when procurement returns PO number. :thumbsup:
